mapper.sql: CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, STATION_CODE, LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS, HEARTBEAT_COUNT, ONLINE_FLAG, CREATE_TMS, UPDATE_TMS
mapper.update: MERGE INTO F2F_DEVICE_STATUS USING ( SELECT #{channel,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS CHANNEL, #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS DEVICE_ID, #{stationCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS STATION_CODE, #{heartbeatTms,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AS LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS FROM DUAL ) SRC ON (F2F_DEVICE_STATUS.CHANNEL = SRC.CHANNEL AND F2F_DEVICE_STATUS.DEVICE_ID = SRC.DEVICE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET STATION_CODE = NVL(SRC.STATION_CODE, F2F_DEVICE_STATUS.STATION_CODE), LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS = SRC.LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS, HEARTBEAT_COUNT = F2F_DEVICE_STATUS.HEARTBEAT_COUNT + 1, ONLINE_FLAG = '1', UPDATE_TMS = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CHANNEL, DEVICE_ID, STATION_CODE, LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS, HEARTBEAT_COUNT, ONLINE_FLAG, CREATE_TMS, UPDATE_TMS) VALUES (SRC.CHANNEL, SRC.DEVICE_ID, SRC.STATION_CODE, SRC.LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS, 1, '1', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM F2F_DEVICE_STATUS WHERE LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS < #{deadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND ONLINE_FLAG = '1' ORDER BY LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS FETCH FIRST #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE F2F_DEVICE_STATUS SET ONLINE_FLAG = '0', UPDATE_TMS = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS < #{deadline,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND ONLINE_FLAG = '1'
mapper.select:
SELECT D.CHANNEL AS channel, D.DEVICE_ID AS deviceId, D.STATION_CODE AS stationCode, S.STATION_NAME AS stationName, D.ONLINE_FLAG AS onlineFlag, TO_CHAR(D.LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS lastHeartbeatTms, ROUND((CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS DATE) - CAST(D.LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS AS DATE)) * 86400) AS idleSeconds, D.HEARTBEAT_COUNT AS heartbeatCount, TO_CHAR(D.UPDATE_TMS, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS updateTms FROM F2F_DEVICE_STATUS D LEFT JOIN STATION_INFO S ON S.STATION_CODE = D.STATION_CODE
ORDER BY D.ONLINE_FLAG ASC, D.LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS DESC, D.DEVICE_ID ASC OFFSET #{offset,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(1) AS total, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ONLINE_FLAG = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS onlineCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ONLINE_FLAG = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS offlineCount, TO_CHAR(MAX(LAST_HEARTBEAT_TMS), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS lastHeartbeatTms FROM F2F_DEVICE_STATUS
